title: A GPU job trained on the CPU on a driver-mismatched node and produced a real-looking metric
symptom: nvidia-smi reported 'Failed to initialize NVML: Driver/library version mismatch', torch fell back silently, one epoch took 48 minutes instead of about two, and the run reported mAP50-95 0.566 before hitting its walltime in validation.
root_cause: torch's CPU fallback is silent, and Slurm keeps scheduling onto that node because it is not drained.
correction_made: train_yolo_mega refuses to start when CUDA is unavailable inside a job that was allocated GPUs; WEED_ALLOW_CPU_TRAIN=1 re-enables the fallback for a deliberate CPU run.
